items.title: Investment giants join forces to form largest healthcare firm on the globe
items.summary: The new healthcare firm will operate across the North American, APAC and European markets, which make up around 90% of the global R&D spend.

items.title: Clinical Trials Day 2026: ‘Research Rising’ theme reflected in Q1 study growth
items.summary: As China continues to inch ahead of competition in terms of trial initiations, immunology and metabolic disease trials attract sponsor eyes.

items.title: Takeda faces $885m hit after landmark pay-for-delay lawsuit verdict
items.summary: Takeda confirmed it would appeal the outcome, stating that the case “lacks merit”.

items.title: QIAGEN and NVIDIA partner on AI drug discovery
items.summary: QIAGEN’s Digital Insights bioinformatics division is set to integrate NVIDIA’s accelerated computing and the BioNeMo platform to enhance AI-driven drug discovery.

items.title: SERB signs agreement to acquire Idefirix rights for $133.6m
items.summary: SERB Pharmaceuticals has signed an agreement to acquire exclusive development and commercialisation rights to Idefirix from Hansa Biopharma for a total of $133.6m.
